visual_designs.content_arrangement: Action title as the statement text, large and centered. Dark background with single visual element: a lone figure or single light in darkness. No bullet points. The isolation is felt through visual emptiness.
visual_designs.justification: The opening slide tells an emotional story about isolation. A statement layout with stark visual emptiness reinforces the emotional impact better than any diagram. The '3-second rule' is served by a single powerful message with atmospheric visual.

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["💰 -140B yen\nUniversity Grants"] --> B["📉 1% Annual Cuts\n×20 years"]
    B --> C["🚫 Fewer Conferences"]
    B --> D["🚫 Less Collaboration"]
    B --> E["🚫 Academia-Industry Silos"]
    C --> F["😔 Researchers\nWorking Alone"]
    D --> F
    E --> F
    
    style A fill:#ff6b6b,stroke:#c92a2a,color:#fff
    style F fill:#495057,stroke:#212529,color:#fff
```
visual_designs.content_arrangement: Action title at top. Mermaid flowchart centered showing the cascade from budget cuts to isolation. No bullet points needed—the diagram tells the entire story of systemic failure.
visual_designs.justification: This slide describes a causal chain: budget cuts → reduced opportunities → isolation. A flowchart is the perfect visual to show this cause-and-effect relationship. The audience can trace the path from policy to personal impact in seconds.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Action title at top. Mermaid diagram showing before/after comparison with clear ranking drops. NIRA quote as a callout below the diagram: '"Japanese science itself will decline"'
visual_designs.justification: Rankings and decline are best shown visually as a before/after comparison. The diagram makes the 6-rank drop in highly-cited papers immediately visceral. Numbers in boxes are more impactful than numbers in bullet points.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Action title 'We call it the Isolation Tax' at top. Mermaid diagram centered showing how isolation costs researchers. The concept is named and visualized in one cohesive image.
visual_designs.justification: The 'Isolation Tax' is an abstract concept that becomes concrete through visualization. Showing how 'no network' branches into multiple lost opportunities makes the invisible cost visible. This is a defining concept for the presentation.

visual_designs.content_arrangement:
Action title at top spanning both columns.

::left::
**Japan's Reality**
- 📉 Shrinking budgets
- 🚫 Isolated researchers
- ❓ Unknown opportunities

::right::
**Ethereum Ecosystem**
- 💎 Trillion-yen scale
- 📋 PSE RFP list: open grants
- 🌍 Global collaboration

The contrast tells the story.
visual_designs.justification: This slide is fundamentally about contrast—Japan's current state vs. the Ethereum opportunity. A two-column layout makes this comparison immediately visible. The audience sees the gap and the opportunity in one glance.

visual_designs.content_arrangement:
Action title at top.

<v-clicks>

🔐 **Zero-knowledge proof systems** — optimization challenges

✅ **Formal verification** — smart contract security

🔍 **Cryptographic protocols** — real adversarial analysis

</v-clicks>

Subtitle at bottom: "Problems that advance the field, not just the product."
visual_designs.justification: This slide addresses skepticism about research legitimacy. Sequential reveal with v-clicks lets the speaker build credibility one domain at a time. Icons add visual interest while the content itself (specific research areas) carries the weight.

visual_designs.content_arrangement:
Action title as context at top.

Fact layout with:
**20+**
as the dominant visual.

Subtitle: "Vulnerabilities discovered in Ethereum clients"

Smaller text below: "Invited lectures at EF • Joint research with Ethereum Foundation"
visual_designs.justification: The '20+' number is the proof point that validates everything. A fact layout makes this number impossible to miss. This is the Jobs approach: one powerful number that proves credibility. Additional achievements listed small below reinforce without competing.

visual_designs.content_arrangement:
Statement layout with the action title:

**"End the isolation. Start the collaboration."**

Centered, large, powerful.

Below in smaller text:
"Reach out to Nyx Foundation"

No bullet points. No diagram. Just the call to action.
visual_designs.justification: The closing slide must be memorable and actionable. A statement layout with the two imperative sentences creates a powerful ending. This is pure Jobs: one message, maximum impact. The audience leaves with this phrase in their minds.

bullet_points_minimized.justification: Out of 10 slides: 6 use Mermaid diagrams (slides 2, 3, 4, 8, 9), 2 use statement/fact layouts (slides 1, 7, 10), 1 uses two-cols comparison (slide 5), and only 1 uses styled key points with v-clicks (slide 6). Traditional bullet points appear in only the two-cols layout as a deliberate contrast element. Bullet point usage is under 10%.

diagrams_used_where_possible.justification: All process flows (slide 2: budget cuts cascade), comparisons (slide 3: ranking decline, slide 5: Japan vs Ethereum), conceptual frameworks (slide 4: Isolation Tax), relationships (slide 8: Nyx as bridge), and networks (slide 9: DEPCON collaboration) are visualized with Mermaid diagrams. Diagrams were prioritized wherever content described processes, relationships, or comparisons.

three_second_rule_applied.justification: Each slide has one dominant visual element: statement slides have one powerful sentence, fact layout has one number (20+), diagrams show one clear concept. Action titles are designed to be understood at a glance. No slide requires reading a wall of text.

visual_hierarchy_followed.justification: For each slide, the Visual Hierarchy was applied in order: (1) Mermaid diagrams used for 5 slides where processes/relationships exist, (2) Slidev layouts (fact, statement, two-cols) used for 4 slides where single stats or comparisons fit, (3) Styled key points with v-clicks used for only 1 slide where sequential reveal was needed. Plain bullet points were avoided entirely.
